CHARTER
The Charter was last amended by provisions approved November 3, 2022.
DIVISION I.
ARTICLE I:

SEC. 1.100. NAME AND BOUNDARIES.

The City and County of San Francisco shall continue as a consolidated City and County with such boundaries as are or may hereafter be established by law.

SEC. 1.101. RIGHTS AND POWERS.

The City and County of San Francisco may make and enforce all ordinances and regulations in respect to municipal affairs, subject only to the restrictions set forth in this Charter. See Section 1.1 of the Transportation Code.

SEC. 1.102. [Reserved.]

SEC. 1.103. [Redesignated.]

This section was redesignated as Section 1.105.

APPENDIX A. — BOUNDARY DESCRIPTIONS

The boundaries of the City and County are described herein.

2023 ORDINANCES

Ordinance 47-23 amended the Charter on March 15, 2023.

2023 RESOLUTIONS

Resolution 12-23 urged the state legislature on April 1, 2023.
TRANSPORTATION CODE
Division I of the Transportation Code was last amended by Ordinance 122-25.
DIVISION I.
ARTICLE 1:

SEC. 1.1. DEFINITIONS.

(a) Whenever in this Transportation Code words or phrases are used that are not defined by the provisions of this Code, they shall have the meanings set forth in the Vehicle Code. (b) "Director of Transportation" means the Director of the Municipal Transportation Agency.

SEC. 1.2. CITY UNDERTAKING LIMITED TO PROMOTION OF GENERAL WELFARE.

In undertaking the adoption and enforcement of this Division I, the City is assuming an undertaking only to promote the general welfare. See Section 1.100 of the Charter.

SEC. 1.3. APPLICABILITY OF VEHICLE CODE.

(a) The provisions of the San Francisco Transportation Code shall be construed in a manner consistent with the Vehicle Code of the State of California.

SEC. 1.4. TRANSFER OF REGULATORY AUTHORITY.

Regulatory authority over motor vehicles for hire is hereby transferred to the Municipal Transportation Agency.

SEC. 1.5. SEVERABILITY.

If any provision of this Code is held unconstitutional or invalid, the remainder of the Code shall not be affected.

SEC. 1.6*. EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section shall take effect upon adoption.
